description: Flat metadata schema for records describing medicinal plant genome sequencing, biosynthetic gene cluster identification, pathway annotation, and alkaloid chemical characterization.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record within the dataset.

plant_species_scientific_name.descr: Accepted scientific name of the medicinal plant species studied, e.g., 'Papaver somniferum'.

plant_species_common_name.descr: Common name of the plant species, if available.

taxon_id.descr: Taxonomic identifier for the species, if available, such as NCBI Taxonomy ID or internal taxon code.

plant_family.descr: Botanical family of the plant species, e.g., 'Papaveraceae'.

specimen_voucher_id.descr: Voucher or herbarium specimen identifier linked to the sampled plant material.

specimen_collection_site.descr: Geographic location where the specimen was collected, preferably in a standardized locality string.

specimen_latitude.descr: Latitude of the collection site in decimal degrees.

specimen_longitude.descr: Longitude of the collection site in decimal degrees.

specimen_collection_date.descr: Date the plant specimen was collected.

plant_tissue_type.descr: Plant tissue used for DNA/RNA/metabolite analysis, e.g., leaf, root, latex, seed, bark.

biosynthetic_pathway_name.descr: Name of the inferred or studied biosynthetic pathway leading to alkaloid production, e.g., benzylisoquinoline alkaloid pathway.

alkaloid_class.descr: Chemical class of alkaloids studied, e.g., indole, isoquinoline, pyrrolizidine, tropane.

target_alkaloid_name.descr: Name of the specific alkaloid or alkaloid mixture characterized in the record.

target_alkaloid_identifiers.descr: External chemical identifiers for the alkaloid, such as PubChem CID, ChEBI ID, or InChIKey.

metabolite_detected.descr: Whether the target alkaloid or related metabolite was detected in the sample.

metabolite_abundance.descr: Relative or absolute abundance of the alkaloid in the analyzed sample, with units defined in accompanying method metadata if absolute.

metabolite_abundance_unit.descr: Unit for metabolite abundance, e.g., ng/g dry weight, peak area, relative intensity.

metabolite_structure_confirmed.descr: Whether chemical structure was confirmed by orthogonal methods such as MS/MS, NMR, or authentic standard comparison.

chemical_characterization_method.descr: Primary analytical method used for alkaloid characterization, e.g., LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, NMR.

chemical_characterization_instrument.descr: Instrument model or platform used for chemical analysis.

chemical_characterization_protocol_ref.descr: Protocol, SOP, publication, or internal reference describing the chemical analysis workflow.

genome_assembly_id.descr: Identifier for the genome assembly used for locus discovery.

genome_assembly_version.descr: Version or release label of the genome assembly.

genome_assembly_size_mb.descr: Total genome assembly size in megabases (Mb).

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used for genome generation, e.g., Illumina, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used, e.g., paired-end short reads, HiFi, hybrid assembly.

sequencing_coverage_x.descr: Approximate sequencing depth or coverage in fold redundancy (x).

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for DNA extraction from plant material.

rna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for RNA extraction, if transcript evidence was used.

transcriptome_evidence_used.descr: Whether transcriptome data were used to support gene annotation or pathway inference.

genome_annotation_method.descr: Primary method used for structural and functional gene annotation, e.g., MAKER, Augustus, manual curation.

biosynthetic_gene_cluster_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster or locus.

biosynthetic_gene_cluster_name.descr: Name or label assigned to the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_contig_id.descr: Contig or scaffold identifier on which the gene cluster is located.

cluster_chromosome.descr: Chromosome or pseudochromosome identifier containing the cluster, if assembled to chromosome level.

cluster_start_bp.descr: Start coordinate of the cluster on the contig/chromosome in base pairs.

cluster_end_bp.descr: End coordinate of the cluster on the contig/chromosome in base pairs.

cluster_length_bp.descr: Length of the biosynthetic gene cluster region in base pairs.

cluster_gene_count.descr: Number of genes annotated within the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_predicted_product.descr: Predicted metabolic product or product class associated with the cluster.

cluster_confidence_score.descr: Confidence score for cluster prediction or annotation, typically normalized from 0 to 1 or reported as a study-specific score.

cluster_detection_method.descr: Method used to identify the biosynthetic gene cluster, e.g., comparative genomics, HMM search, manual curation.

cluster_validation_status.descr: Status of cluster validation, e.g., predicted, supported by expression, experimentally validated.

gene_id.descr: Unique identifier of the gene annotated in the pathway or cluster.

gene_symbol.descr: Short gene symbol or locus tag, if assigned.

gene_product_name.descr: Functional name of the encoded protein or enzyme.

gene_function_annotation.descr: Curated functional annotation describing the enzyme role in alkaloid biosynthesis.

gene_uniprot_id.descr: UniProt accession or other protein database identifier, if available.

gene_start_bp.descr: Start coordinate of the gene on the contig/chromosome in base pairs.

gene_end_bp.descr: End coordinate of the gene on the contig/chromosome in base pairs.

gene_strand.descr: Genomic strand of the gene, typically '+' or '-' in the source annotation.

gene_exon_count.descr: Number of exons annotated for the gene.

gene_copy_number.descr: Estimated copy number of the gene in the genome, if assessed.

gene_expression_level.descr: Expression level of the gene, such as TPM, FPKM, or normalized counts, if transcriptomics was performed.

gene_expression_unit.descr: Unit for gene expression level, e.g., TPM, FPKM, counts per million.

gene_expression_evidence.descr: Whether gene expression evidence supports the annotation or pathway assignment.

gene_homology_hit.descr: Best homologous reference gene or protein used to infer function.

gene_homology_identity_pct.descr: Percent sequence identity to the best homologous reference.

gene_homology_coverage_pct.descr: Percent alignment coverage to the reference sequence.

pathway_step_number.descr: Ordinal step number of the gene's role in the biosynthetic pathway.

pathway_reaction_name.descr: Name of the biochemical reaction catalyzed or supported by the gene product.

pathway_substrate.descr: Primary substrate for the enzymatic step.

pathway_product.descr: Primary product of the enzymatic step.

pathway_cofactor.descr: Required cofactor or cosubstrate, if known.

pathway_subcellular_localization.descr: Predicted or known subcellular compartment where the pathway step occurs, e.g., cytosol, plastid, ER.

pathway_evidence_type.descr: Type of evidence supporting the pathway assignment, e.g., homology, coexpression, metabolomics, biochemical assay.

pathway_evidence_score.descr: Quantitative score summarizing support for the pathway assignment.

ortholog_group_id.descr: Ortholog group or gene family identifier for comparative analyses.

phylogenetic_clade.descr: Phylogenetic clade or lineage relevant to the gene or species comparison.

manual_curation_flag.descr: Whether the annotation was manually curated after automated prediction.

annotation_author.descr: Name or identifier of the person or pipeline responsible for the annotation.

annotation_date.descr: Date on which the gene or cluster annotation was finalized.

analysis_pipeline_name.descr: Name of the computational pipeline used for genome assembly, annotation, or cluster mining.

software_dependencies.descr: Primary software tools used, recorded as a single string or comma-separated list if needed.

reference_genome_used.descr: Whether a reference genome was used during assembly or annotation.

reference_genome_accession.descr: Accession of the reference genome used, if applicable.

quality_metric_name.descr: Name of the key quality metric reported for the record, such as BUSCO, completeness, or annotation score.

quality_metric_unit.descr: Unit or scale for the quality metric, if applicable.

data_file_identifier.descr: Identifier or accession for the underlying raw or processed data file associated with this record.

data_file_format.descr: File format of the associated data, e.g., FASTA, GFF3, TSV, mzML, MGF.

data_access_url.descr: Direct URL or repository link where the associated data can be accessed.

license_type.descr: Reuse license for the record-associated data, e.g., CC-BY-4.0, CC0, restricted.
